growth.title: Every worker doubles the desk
growth.caption: Reachable states as TLC counted them, on a log scale: each bar is 2N + 2^N. Past the break, the bar for 300 workers would need a number with 91 digits; it leaves the chart.

dominoes.title: Two checks cover the whole row
dominoes.caption: Condition 1 pushes the first domino. Condition 2 says every domino, whichever one it is, knocks over the next. Together they cover the row however long it is; condition 3 turns "fallen" into "no double payout".

cti.title: A step out of a state nobody reaches
cti.caption: With two workers, 96 states satisfy NoDoublePayout but only 8 are reachable. The CTI starts in the gap between them: a state the desk never visits, one step from paying twice.

strengthen.title: Two rounds of strengthening
strengthen.caption: Each round adds a conjunct that rules out the last CTI's first state and keeps every reachable state: 96, then 72, then 49 states. Inside Inv, every step stays inside, which is why TLC reports depth 1.

one-worker.title: One step moves one worker
one-worker.caption: One step of a 300-worker desk. Send moves one worker: one claim fewer, one transfer more, and the budget stays at 1. The other 299 workers play no part, which is why the argument works for any number of them.
